solutions.title: Check every possible start
solutions.strategy: Try each candidate start in the text and compare the pattern character by character.

timeComplexity.explanation: There are up to n candidate starts, and each can compare up to m pattern characters before failing or matching.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The scan stores only loop indices and does not allocate data proportional to either string.

solutions.title: KMP prefix table
solutions.strategy: Build the pattern prefix table and reuse previous match information instead of restarting comparisons after each mismatch.

timeComplexity.explanation: The prefix table scans the pattern once, and the search advances through the text while moving the pattern pointer backward only via table links.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The prefix table stores one integer for each pattern position.
